description: FREE lite Racket Check of a local service provider's website URL. Runs the same scan as racket_check but returns the verdict (CLEAN / PLAN_PUSH / RACKET / UNKNOWN) and the 0-100 score only — no evidence snippets, no signal detail. Use this to triage whether a provider deserves the full racket_check report, or call racket_check directly for the complete evidence-backed scan.

url.description: Service provider website URL to check for racket signals, e.g. https://example-lawncare.com

name: racket_check_lite
